test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Our team is all __on the same page__ when it comes to our goals for the upcoming project.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Be in agreement**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"on the same page"** means to be in agreement with others about something. (सहमत होना)

 
 
• **Example:** The management team is **on the same page** about the new policy changes.
 
 
 
• **"Be in agreement"** means to share the same opinion or perspective as others. (एकमत होना)
 
 
• **Example:** All the members **were in agreement** regarding the decision to expand the business.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct meaning of the idiom is Be in agreement.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Be confused** (उलझन में होना): To not understand something clearly.

 
 
• **Example:** He was **confused **about the instructions given for the project.
 
 
 
• **Be unsure** (अनिश्चित होना): To not be certain about something.
 
 
• **Example:** She was **unsure **whether she should accept the job offer.
 
 
 
• **Be in conflict** (विवाद में होना): To have a disagreement or argument with someone.
 
 
• **Example:** The two departments were **in conflict** over the allocation of resources.
